review_pelicanconf: review the pelicanconf.py configuration file for site metadata, theme, and markdown extension settings
summarize_pelicanconf: summarize the pelican static site generator configuration including author, feeds, and markdown options
refactor_pelicanconf: refactor the pelicanconf.py to enable feed generation or add social links and blogroll entries
test_pelicanconf: test the pelicanconf.py configuration by verifying markdown extension configs and static paths are valid
build_pelicanconf: build a pelican static site using pelicanconf.py with the configured theme, markdown extensions, and pagination settings
